pick.name: Linear
pick.what: Fast keyboard-first issue tracker with cycles, roadmaps and an official remote MCP
pick.why: Best UX and speed for a small product team; official MCP (claude mcp add --transport http linear-server https://mcp.linear.app/mcp)
pick.free_limits: Free: 250 issues total, 2 teams, unlimited members, 10 MB uploads; Basic $10/user/mo (annual)

best_free.name: GitHub Issues + Projects
best_free.what: Issues, milestones and Projects boards/tables/roadmaps next to the code
best_free.why: No issue cap; Claude Code drives it through gh CLI and the GitHub MCP; issues link to PRs and releases
best_free.free_limits: Included on GitHub Free; up to 50 fields per project
best_free.install: web; CLI: brew install gh | winget install -e --id GitHub.cli

alts.name: Plane
alts.what: Open-source project management with cycles, modules and pages
alts.why: Self-hostable Linear-style tracker; free plan up to 12 users
alts.free_limits: Free: 12 users, no AI credits/time tracking/integrations; Pro $6/user/mo annual
alts.maintained: pricing page current; repo licence not checked

alts.name: Jira
alts.why: Flips the choice when you need compliance, deep workflows or sell into Atlassian shops
alts.free_limits: Free/Standard/Premium plans exist; figures not readable on the fetched page

candidates.name: Linear
candidates.verdict: PICK: best UX + MCP; 250-issue free cap is the limit

candidates.name: GitHub Issues + Projects
candidates.verdict: BEST FREE: uncapped, native to the code

candidates.name: Jira
candidates.verdict: Heavy for a solo founder; wins with enterprise needs

candidates.name: Notion databases
candidates.verdict: Workable for tiny backlogs; weak code linkage

decision: Linear is the best tracker for a small product team: speed, cycles and an official MCP for Claude Code. GitHub Issues + Projects is the zero-cost, uncapped alternative and often enough solo. Switch from free Linear to paid (or to GitHub) when the 250-issue cap bites.

verify.note: Verified: Free 250 issues, 2 teams, unlimited members, 10 MB/file; Basic $10, Business $16 per user/mo annual.
